report: Revision algebra (SPEC section 2): the author's T16 gamma matrices re-constructed and verified in WolframScript
coordinates: x1, x2, x3 = 3-space; x4 = time; x5, x6, x7 = the exponentially deflating extra times; x8 = the hidden direction

checks.name: s4_t4_entries_from_Signature_and_deltas
checks.detail: s4[h]_pq = Signature[{h,p,q,4}] - (d_p4 d_qh - d_ph d_q4), t4[h]_pq = Signature[{h,p,q,4}] + (d_p4 d_qh - d_ph d_q4), h = 1..3, p, q = 1..4 (the author's Qa -+ Qb), re-checked entry by entry with KroneckerDelta

checks.name: s4_self_dual_t4_anti_self_dual
checks.detail: (1/2) eps_pqrs s4[h]_rs = s4[h] and (1/2) eps_pqrs t4[h]_rs = -t4[h] for h = 1, 2, 3 (the notebook's SelfDualAntiSymmetric / AntiSelfDualAntiSymmetric)

checks.name: s4_t4_quaternion_algebras
checks.detail: {s4[h], s4[k]} = {t4[h], t4[k]} = -2 delta_hk I4, [s4[h], t4[k]] = 0, all six antisymmetric: two commuting copies of the imaginary quaternions

checks.name: sigma8_involution
checks.detail: sigma = {{0, I4}, {I4, 0}}: sigma^2 = I8, Tr sigma = 0, sigma symmetric

checks.name: tau_taubar_Clifford_relation
checks.detail: tau[A] taubar[B] + tau[B] taubar[A] = taubar[A] tau[B] + taubar[B] tau[A] = 2 eta4488_AB I8 for A, B = 0..7, eta4488 = diag(1,1,1,1,-1,-1,-1,-1) (the notebook's frame order)

checks.name: tau7_and_sigma_identities
checks.detail: sigma = tau[1] tau[2] tau[3] = tau[4] tau[5] tau[6] tau[7] and sigma taubar[A] = (sigma tau[A])^T, A = 0..7 (identities stated in the notebook, re-verified)

checks.name: coordinate_map
checks.detail: gamma^(x1..x3) = T16[1..3], gamma^(x4) = T16[4], gamma^(x5..x7) = T16[5..7], gamma^(x8) = T16[0] (SPEC section 2)

checks.name: eta_in_author_order
checks.detail: eta = diag(+1,+1,+1,-1,-1,-1,-1,+1) in the order x1..x8 (read off from the notebook's eta4488 through the frame map): space-like x1, x2, x3, x8; time-like x4, x5, x6, x7

checks.name: Clifford_relation
checks.detail: {gamma^a, gamma^b} = 2 eta^ab I16 for all 64 pairs a, b in x1..x8 (exact integer arithmetic); squares: x1:1, x2:1, x3:1, x4:-1, x5:-1, x6:-1, x7:-1, x8:1

checks.name: reality
checks.detail: every gamma^a is a real 16 x 16 matrix with entries in {-1, 0, 1}

checks.name: signed_permutation_matrices
checks.detail: every gamma^a has exactly one nonzero entry (+-1) in each row and each column (a signed permutation matrix, hence orthogonal)

checks.name: symmetry_pattern
checks.detail: gamma^T = eta gamma (no sum): x1 symmetric, x2 symmetric, x3 symmetric, x4 antisymmetric, x5 antisymmetric, x6 antisymmetric, x7 antisymmetric, x8 symmetric (the space-like gammas symmetric, the time-like antisymmetric)

checks.name: C_definition
checks.detail: C = gamma^(x8) gamma^(x1) gamma^(x2) gamma^(x3) = the notebook's sigma16 = T16[0] T16[1] T16[2] T16[3]

checks.name: C_real_symmetric
checks.detail: C is a real (integer) symmetric matrix

checks.name: C_gamma_real_antisymmetric
checks.detail: C gamma^a is real and antisymmetric for every a in x1..x8 (so Psibar gamma^a Psi = Psi^dagger C gamma^a Psi; for real commuting spinors it vanishes)

checks.name: C_gamma_C_inverse
checks.detail: C gamma^a C^-1 = -(gamma^a)^T for every a (equivalent statement)

checks.name: Gamma_definition
checks.detail: Gamma = gamma^(x8) gamma^(x1) ... gamma^(x7) = the notebook's T16[8] = T16[0] ... T16[7]

checks.name: Gamma_diag
checks.detail: Gamma = diag(-I8, I8)

checks.name: Gamma_anticommutes_with_gammas
checks.detail: {Gamma, gamma^a} = 0 for all a, Gamma^2 = I16

checks.name: Gamma_commutes_with_C
checks.detail: [Gamma, C] = 0 (C is a product of an even number of gammas)

checks.name: notebook_product_identity
checks.detail: T16[0] T16[1] ... T16[7] T16[8] = I16 (an identity stated in the notebook; it is Gamma^2 = I16)

checks.name: B_definition
checks.detail: B = -i C gamma^(x4)

checks.name: B_Hermitian
checks.detail: B^dagger = B

checks.name: B_signature_8_8
checks.detail: the exact eigenvalues of B are +1 (multiplicity 8) and -1 (multiplicity 8), Tr B = 0: the Hermitian form Psi^dagger B Psi has signature (8, 8)

checks.name: B_purely_imaginary
checks.detail: B = i K with K = -C gamma^(x4) a real antisymmetric integer matrix

checks.name: S_antisymmetric_in_ab
checks.detail: S^ab = -S^ba, S^aa = 0

checks.name: S_half_product
checks.detail: S^ab = (1/2) gamma^a gamma^b for a != b

checks.name: S_real_entries_in_half_integers
checks.detail: every S^ab is real with entries in {-1/2, 0, 1/2}

checks.name: S_gamma_commutator
checks.detail: [S^ab, gamma^c] = eta^bc gamma^a - eta^ac gamma^b for all 512 triples (gamma^a is a vector under the generators S^ab)

checks.name: S_Lorentz_algebra
checks.detail: [S^ab, S^cd] = eta^bc S^ad - eta^ac S^bd - eta^bd S^ac + eta^ad S^bc for all a < b, c < d: the Lie algebra so(4,4)

checks.name: S_preserves_C
checks.detail: S^T C + C S = 0 (equivalently S^dagger C + C S = 0, S real) for every S^ab: Psibar Psi = Psi^dagger C Psi is Spin(4,4) invariant

checks.name: S_preserves_B_only_off_x4
checks.detail: S^dagger B + B S = 0 holds exactly for the 21 generators S^ab with a, b != x4; for the 7 generators S^(x4 b) it equals i C gamma^b != 0 (exact): the Hermitian form Psi^dagger B Psi (signature (8,8)) is invariant under the Spin(4,3) that fixes the x4 direction, not under all of Spin(4,4) (B = -i C gamma^(x4) singles out the time x4, like Psi^dagger Psi in Minkowski space); the Spin(4,4)-invariant form is Psibar Psi = Psi^dagger C Psi

checks.name: S_commutes_with_Gamma
checks.detail: [S^ab, Gamma] = 0: every S^ab is block diagonal in the chiral halves (Gamma = -1: rows 1..8, Gamma = +1: rows 9..16)

checks.name: Clifford_basis_spans_full_matrix_algebra
checks.detail: the 256 ordered products gamma^(a1)...gamma^(ak) (a1 < ... < ak, k = 0..8) are linearly independent: span dimension 256 = 16^2, so the gammas generate all of Mat(16, R) (and Mat(16, C) over C)

checks.name: even_subalgebra_dimension
checks.detail: the even products (k = 0, 2, 4, 6, 8) span a space of dimension 128 = 2 x 8^2: Mat(8) + Mat(8), the even Clifford algebra generated by Spin(4,4)

checks.name: Pin44_irreducible_commutant_dim_1
checks.detail: the commutant {X : X gamma^a = gamma^a X, a = x1..x8} has dimension 1 and is spanned by I16 (exact NullSpace over Q; the gammas are rational, so the complex commutant has the same dimension). Pin(4,4) is generated by the unit vectors v^a gamma_a and its linear span is the whole Clifford algebra, so its commutant is this one: the 16-dimensional representation is irreducible under Pin(4,4) (Schur, over C)

checks.name: Spin44_commutant_dim_2_chiral_projectors
checks.detail: the commutant of the 28 generators S^ab (a < b) has dimension 2 and is spanned by the chiral projectors P_L = (I - Gamma)/2, P_R = (I + Gamma)/2 (rank 8 each, P_L + P_R = I, P_L P_R = 0); the S^ab generate the Lie algebra of Spin(4,4), whose identity component is generated by exp of it

checks.name: chiral_halves_irreducible
checks.detail: the S^ab restricted to the Gamma = -1 half (rows 1..8) and to the Gamma = +1 half (rows 9..16): commutant dimensions 1 and 1: each 8-dimensional half is irreducible

checks.name: chiral_halves_inequivalent_intertwiners_0
checks.detail: the spaces of intertwiners {X : X S_L^ab = S_R^ab X} and {X : X S_R^ab = S_L^ab X} (all a < b) have dimensions 0 and 0: the two 8-dimensional irreducible representations of Spin(4,4) are inequivalent

checks.name: Spin_Pin_reflection_swaps_halves
checks.detail: every gamma^a (a reflection in Pin(4,4) of determinant -1) is block off-diagonal: it exchanges the two chiral halves, which is how the inequivalent halves combine into one Pin(4,4) irrep

checks.name: fixture_written_deterministically
checks.detail: gammas.json text generated twice in this run is identical (no time stamps), LF line endings only, 76968 characters

checks.name: fixture_round_trip
checks.detail: gammas.json re-imported and decoded reproduces gamma, C, Gamma, B, S and eta exactly
